notes: Forward-compatible application schema 112 to 113. Migrations through 112 are immutable applied production history. Migration 113 adds a service-role-only, invoker-rights managed-asset visibility context RPC. The application retains its complete legacy authorization path only while this RPC is absent during the guarded post-acceptance migration window. A verified schema-112 backup is required before migration; recovery is forward-repair-only after schema advances beyond 112.
